0 = unlimited. Reasoning models without a cap can write tens of thousands of characters of thinking; a group turn can take over ten minutes.
The same agent can join a group several times; each instance gets its own context and runs independently.
Auto = pick by member count; Parallel = all at once; Chain = one after another; Review = executor and reviewer alternate.
Round robin = everyone speaks once, then turn-taking by priority; Moderated = a moderator model picks the next speaker step by step (one extra lightweight request per step).
A subagent spawned by the main agent counts as level 1. Deeper levels multiply calls; the default is two.
